declaredIdentity: Tenant singleton, observed Sequence value, reasons per member, append OCC. Reasons suppress immediate duplicate withdrawal but no operation/generation token binds source write or restoration.
invariant: Removal from effective administrator set must leave another active tenant administrator.
boundaryRationale: Without a shared authoritative decision/hold two removals could each rely on the other. The coordination boundary is justified; guard-to-member transition protocol is incomplete.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: deterministic receiver identity derived from the admitted root fact, episode and generation; exact redelivery resolves the original result

selectedCommandContracts.guard: Source fact must carry exact withdrawal operation/generation; settle only that reason/hold.
selectedCommandContracts.failure: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.

selectedCommandContracts.guard: Verify exact source restoration for the same member episode/assignment generation. Clear only its matching withdrawal reason. If other reasons/current suspension remain, record completed restoration without restoring availability; never clear suspended/deprovisioned reasons merely because admin team assignment succeeded.

baselineIdentityObservation: Tenant singleton, observed Sequence value, reasons per member, append OCC. Reasons suppress immediate duplicate withdrawal but no operation/generation token binds source write or restoration.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Tenant singleton manager guard in its existing address. Selected CommandId binds exact contributor/member episode, generation and withdrawal/restoration transition; current complete eligible contributors remain authoritative.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant singleton manager guard in its existing address. Selected CommandId binds exact contributor/member episode, generation and withdrawal/restoration transition; current complete eligible contributors remain authoritative.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

productRules.rule: The last active tenant administrator cannot be deprovisioned.

decides: Administrator admission exactly selects the historical membership episode and its pending restoration, so a withdrawal or deprovisioning cannot drop the set below one active administrator.
